templateFile.label: Template File
templateFile.hint: A Handlebars template that renders to JSON data suitable for Document creation.

csvFile.label: Data File
csvFile.hint: CSV or TSV file to apply to the template.  Column names are required.  Spaces in the column names will be replaced with underscores.

baseFolder.label: Base Folder
baseFolder.hint: Create all documents inside this folder.

folderColumn.label: Folder Field
folderColumn.hint: This column will be used as a folder name for each record.  Will be created under the Base Folder if it does not already exist.

allowPackage.name: Allow system and module packs
allowPackage.hint: For developers.  Allow importing to non-world compendium packs.  WARNING: Any changes to a package's compendium will be overwritten if that module or system updates.
